name: Healing Parasol
desc: A magical umbrella used to summon a healing rain capable of mending wounds. Since rain falls only while the umbrella is open, you have to step out from under the umbrella to be healed.

eff.name: Blessed Rain
eff.desc2: Restores target's HP with [Lv. x 25] power and grants 3 stack(s) of HP Regeneration.

eff.name: Dispel Malice
eff.desc1: Shortens the duration of the target's negative effects by [Lv. x 3] second(s).
eff.desc2: Reduces cooldowns by [Lv. x 3]% when environmental mana gauge is at 50% or higher.

eff.name: Consecutive Activation
eff.desc1: Grants a [Lv. x 2]% chance when using an item that its effect will activate again after 5 second(s).
